offence_note: Sexual assault; breach of conditional sentence house arrest
note: Appeal allowed on interpretation of s. 742.6; breach finding set aside; no new sentence.

offence_note: Distribution of child pornography and child luring
sentence_quote: I would sentence Mr. Trimm to 24 months of imprisonment broken down as follows: a. 12 months for distribution of child pornography (Code, at s. 163.1(3)); and b. 12 months, consecutive, for child luring (Code, at s. 172.1(1)(b)).
note: Reduced from 34 months (22 after totality) to 24 months; trial ancillary orders left in place.

offence_note: Seven robberies, possession of stolen property, theft over $5,000
sentence_quote: a Provincial Court judge sentenced Mr. Morris to a global sentence of three years and 10 months' imprisonment following Mr. Morris's guilty plea to seven counts of robbery
note: Leave granted, appeal dismissed; five year sentence less 14 months credit for seven months custody.

offence_note: Attempted money laundering of drug proceeds; record-keeping offences
sentence_quote: The appeal is allowed, with the sentences reduced from 27 months to 24 months less 1 day to be served unconditionally in incarceration.
note: Conditional sentence refused; reduced from 27 months.

offence_note: Sexual assault, unlawful confinement, uttering threats; long-term offender
sentence_quote: I sentence you on Count 1, sexual assault, to three years imprisonment after giving you two years credit for the time you have already spent in custody.
note: Residential alcohol treatment recommended on release under LTSO; victim surcharge waived; weight of Gladue factors not shown.

offence_note: Bribery, attempt to obstruct justice, breach of trust, trafficking cocaine
sentence_quote: As to the sentence appeal, I would grant leave to appeal sentence, but would dismiss the sentence appeal, with the exception of varying the order regarding time to pay the fine in lieu of forfeiture to one year from the date the appellant is released from custody.
note: Fine in lieu of forfeiture amount not shown; only time to pay varied; former police officer.

sentence_quote: I would grant leave, and allow the Crown's appeal to the extent that a three year probation order is imposed.
note: Crown appeal; jail not increased but three year probation added; offender already released.

offence_note: Second degree murder of common-law wife
sentence_quote: I consider the extension of the parole ineligibility period to 15 years entirely fit for the appellant in the circumstances of the offence he committed
note: Majority dismissed appeal (15 years stands); Lambert J.A. would have reduced to 12 years (dissent ignored).
